scope: Static preflight only; no production source changed, no helper connected, and no test/build command run.

dependencyGate.reason: T03 permits independent fixture/interface preparation before T02 acceptance, but explicitly forbids connecting a fake-success backend.

staticObservations.observation: Previous-window capture embeds PowerShell Add-Type and synchronously calls powershell.exe through spawnSync from the panel show path.
Paste/focus helper is inline PowerShell/C# with Win32 P/Invoke, including Thread.Sleep(180), launched as powershell.exe.
After hiding, a 100ms timer recaptures the current foreground and may substitute it as the paste target before starting the helper.
history:copy writes through Electron clipboard, schedules paste, then marks IPC acknowledgement without awaiting the input outcome.
panel:shown transports only requestId; copyItem invokes history:copy with an item id. No generation or native operation identity is exposed.
copyItem is typed Promise<void>; the shared API has no typed paste result, generation, or helper identity.
